description: Human-in-the-loop approval gate via Slack reactions. Posts the upstream asset's text to a Slack channel, watches for reactions from an allowlisted set of approvers via a companion sensor, writes the same JSON approval token file `HumanApprovalGateComponent` reads — everything downstream of the gate is unchanged. Reactions-polling (not interactive buttons) so it works in Dagster+ Serverless without a public webhook.

outputs.description: One posted-asset (records Slack message_ts + metadata) + one watcher sensor (polls reactions + writes token on quorum).

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: target: human_approval_gate only (required there, ignored for target: agentic_pipeline). Asset whose text is posted to Slack. Slash notation for multi-part keys.

approval_dir.label: Approval Dir
approval_dir.description: Required for target: human_approval_gate / agentic_pipeline; unused (and may be left unset) for target: run_request, which writes no file at all. target: human_approval_gate -- when quorum is reached, writes `<safe_partition_key>.json` here, matching `HumanApprovalGateComponent`'s own `approval_dir` so the existing gate + sensor pipeline just works. target: agentic_pipeline -- the SAME `approval_dir` your pipeline's `approve` step uses; this component reads `<approval_dir>/pending/*.json` from it and writes `<approval_dir>/<key>.json` decisions back into it.

slack_bot_token_env_var.label: Slack Bot Token Env Var
slack_bot_token_env_var.description: Env var with `xoxb-...` bot token (needs chat:write + reactions:read + reactions:write).

approve_emoji.description: Emoji name (no colons) approvers react with. Default `white_check_mark` (✅).
approve_emoji.label: Approve Emoji

reject_emoji.description: Emoji name (no colons) for explicit rejection. Default `x` (❌).
reject_emoji.label: Reject Emoji

ping_users_on_post.label: Ping Users On Post
ping_users_on_post.description: Slack user IDs to @-mention on the initial post so approvers get notifications.

required_approvers.label: Required Approvers
required_approvers.description: How many allowlisted approvers must react approve_emoji before the token is written.

approver_allowlist.label: Approver Allowlist
approver_allowlist.description: Slack user IDs allowed to vote.

timeout_hours.label: Timeout Hours
timeout_hours.description: If quorum isn't reached within this many hours, applies on_timeout policy.

on_timeout.label: On Timeout
on_timeout.description: `escalate` (default — ping escalate_slack_user, keep waiting) \| `reject` (write approved=false token) \| `approve` (write approved=true — use with caution).

escalate_slack_user.label: Escalate Slack User
escalate_slack_user.description: User ID pinged when timeout escalates. Only used with on_timeout=escalate.

poll_interval_seconds.label: Poll Interval Seconds
poll_interval_seconds.description: Sensor cadence for polling Slack reactions.

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly', 'static', 'multi', 'dynamic', or None for unpartitioned.

partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'customer_a,customer_b,customer_c'.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.
partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only (business-day cadence). Built on Dagster's TimeWindowPartitionsDefinition(cron_schedule=...).

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'. Only change this for a sub-daily cron_schedule.

partition_end_offset.label: Partition End Offset
partition_end_offset.description: Passed through to the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition. 0 (the Dagster default) means a time-based partition set only ever holds COMPLETED windows -- e.g. a daily set never includes today until tomorrow. Set to 1 to include the current, still-in-progress window.

partition_timezone.label: Partition Timezone
partition_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition (defaults to UTC when unset, matching Dagster's own default).

backfill_policy.label: Backfill Policy
backfill_policy.description: Backfill execution strategy for a partitioned asset. 'single_run' sends ONE approval request covering the whole backfill range (the range's partition keys are joined into a single request/sidecar-state key, so one approve/reject decision applies to the entire range as a unit) rather than one request per partition. 'multi_run' launches one run -- and one separate approval request -- per partition. Leave empty for Dagster's default (one run per partition, uncapped). Ignored when Partition Type is not set.

backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.label: Backfill Max Partitions Per Run
backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.description: For Backfill Policy = 'multi_run' only: maximum partitions materialized per run. Leave empty for Dagster's default (1).

target.label: Target
target.description: 'human_approval_gate' (default): post `upstream_asset_key`'s text, write a bare decision token for a separately-configured `HumanApprovalGateComponent` to consume -- unchanged from this component's original behavior. 'agentic_pipeline': instead of posting an upstream asset, watch `<approval_dir>/pending/*.json` records -- the review queue agentic_pipeline's own `approve` op writes when it has `mode: park` -- post each pending record's `summary` to Slack, and on quorum write the decision the same way agentic_pipeline's own `approve_pending()` reviewer-tooling helper does (copies the pending record's fingerprint into the token), so the pipeline's own `<asset>_approval_resume_sensor` honours it. `upstream_asset_key` is ignored in this mode (there is no single upstream asset -- the pipeline's own `approve` step is the source of what gets posted); no asset is emitted, only the watcher sensor. 'run_request': same posting behavior as human_approval_gate, but on quorum the watcher directly fires a `RunRequest` (run_request_mode / run_request_job_name / run_request_asset_selection) with the decision on its tags -- no token file, no approval_dir, no separate HumanApprovalGateComponent at all. Requires correlation_mode='message_metadata' (the default).

correlation_mode.label: Correlation Mode
correlation_mode.description: 'message_metadata' (default): no per-pending-approval file at all. The approval's own config (required_approvers, approver_allowlist, timeout_hours, ...) rides inside the Slack message itself as hidden metadata (chat.postMessage's own `metadata` parameter -- invisible in the Slack UI, read back via conversations.history(include_all_metadata=true) under the same scope already needed to read channel history). The watcher discovers pending approvals by scanning the channel (bounded by history_lookback_hours) instead of globbing a directory, and keeps its own escalation-already-sent / already-resolved bookkeeping in Dagster's native sensor cursor -- no approval_dir file for any of this (target: human_approval_gate still writes the one decision-token file that component reads; target: run_request writes no file at all). 'sidecar_file': this component's original behavior -- writes `<approval_dir>/<safe_key>.slack_state.json` at post time and globs it every tick. Kept for exact backward compatibility, or for a Slack app that can't be granted channel-history read on this channel. Not available for target: run_request.

history_lookback_hours.label: History Lookback Hours
history_lookback_hours.description: correlation_mode='message_metadata' only: how far back (hours) the watcher scans channel history for still-open approval messages, bounding the conversations.history call so a busy channel doesn't force a full-history scan every tick. Should be >= timeout_hours (when set); a message older than this that never resolved stops being found by the watcher.

run_request_mode.label: Run Request Mode
run_request_mode.description: target: run_request only. 'job': launch run_request_job_name. 'asset_selection': materialize run_request_asset_selection.

run_request_job_name.label: Run Request Job Name
run_request_job_name.description: target: run_request + run_request_mode='job' (required then). Job name to launch on quorum.

run_request_asset_selection.label: Run Request Asset Selection
run_request_asset_selection.description: target: run_request + run_request_mode='asset_selection' (required then). Asset keys to materialize on quorum.

run_request_run_config.label: Run Request Run Config
run_request_run_config.description: target: run_request only. Optional run config passed through to the launched RunRequest.

run_request_tag_prefix.label: Run Request Tag Prefix
run_request_tag_prefix.description: target: run_request only. Tag namespace on the launched run: '{prefix}/approved' ('true'/'false'), '{prefix}/approver', '{prefix}/reason', '{prefix}/partition_key'.

name: Slack Approval Gate
